name: -6AN to 5/8-20 Long Carburetor Inlet Fitting
title: -6AN to 5/8-20 Long Carburetor Inlet Fitting
description:
The -6AN to 5/8-20 Long Carburetor Inlet Fitting is a premium high-performance component engineered for rigorous fluid and boost applications. ColorFittings Long Carburetor Inlet Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN braided fuel lines directly to your carburetor's fuel bowl inlet, providing a secure, leak-free solution for carbureted fuel systems in racing, street performance, and marine applications.

Each fitting is CNC machined from 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process for maximum strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. The long-style design provides deeper bowl engagement for a more secure fitment and is designed to withstand high pressure and high temperature environments.

their Long Carburetor Inlet Fittings are manufactured to provide a perfect fit and seal when paired with ColorFittings AN fittings, which are specifically engineered for use with E85, ethanol-based fuels, and race fuels. When combined with their nylon or stainless steel braided hose, these fittings deliver reliable performance and clean routing for any high-performance carbureted fuel system.

For best installation results, the manufacturer strongly recommend using their AN Fitting Assembly Tools, which help prevent fitting damage and ensure proper hose and fitting alignment. Please reference their installation video and fitting guide for proper assembly techniques and torque recommendations.

Technical Specifications:
• Construction: Precision CNC-machined in the USA. (6061-T6 Billet Aluminum for fittings)
